## Appendix A: Breakdown of Sectors

-   Sectors were broken down into available subsectors. Further information on the emissions categorized in each subsector are provided in the [2023 British Columbia Climate Change Accountability Report](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/environment/climate-change/action/cleanbc/2023_climate_change_accountability_report.pdf)^2^.
-   Each subsector contributes varying amounts of emissions to the sector total. Examining these breakdowns further can give us a greater insight into the sources of emissions in B.C.
-   In each subsector figure below, the grey background shows the total emissions from each sector over time and the color sections show the contribution of each sub-sector compared to the sector total.
